column1: # SuttaCentral uids of the bundled deck's example sources, checked against
# SuttaCentral's API on 2026-10-17 (53 SuttaCentral link task).
# Columns (tab separated): source (lower case, no spaces) | uid | original
# title | English translators | French translators | Vietnamese translators.
# A translator column lists the authors SuttaCentral holds for that uid and
# language in the preferred order (rule: SuttaCentral's segmented editions
# first, then by author uid); `-` means none.
# How each row was checked (one request per uid, a second for the non-nikaya
# ones): GET /api/suttas/<uid> answers suttaplex.uid == uid (an2.135 answers
# the range an2.130-140: the range is the uid kept), the authors come from its
# `translations`, and for dhp, snp, thag, thig and ud the first words of the
# deck's line were found in GET /api/bilarasuttas/<uid>/sujato?lang=en root
# text. The DPD running numbers (SNP40, TH155, THI71, UD45...) are not
# SuttaCentral's chapter.sutta uids: they were matched by the sutta's name
# (the deck's `sutta` against SuttaCentral's original title) and by that text.
